- Preparing supplier payments via BACS
- Maintaining accurate records of invoices, payments and approvals
- Recording supplier payments within the ERP system
- Processing supplier debit notes for rejected or returned stock
- Reconciling supplier statements
- Dealing with supplier queries via email and telephone
- Posting customer cash receipts
- Recording sales invoices
- Supporting month-end and year-end processing
- Assisting with internal and external audit requirements
- Supporting the wider finance team with additional transactional accounting duties as required

The role is 37.5 hours per week with flexible working. Core availability is required between 9.30am and 3.00pm, with flexibility around start and finish times depending on business requirements.You'll work on a hybrid basis with 3 days per week on-site, with the specific days agreed with the Finance Manager.

What you'll need to succeed

You'll ideally have around 3 years' previous experience within a similar Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or transactional finance position and be comfortable managing a busy workload with minimal supervision.You'll also ideally have:
- Previous Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger experience
- Experience working with an integrated ERP system
- Experience processing BACS and international payments
- Knowledge of VAT
- Basic bookkeeping knowledge
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- The ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
- Confident communication skills when dealing with suppliers and internal stakeholders
- GCSE Maths and English at Grade C/4 or above, or equivalent

What you'll get in return

You'll receive:
- £27,000 - £33,000 salary, dependent on experience
- An initial 3-month fixed-term contract
- Potential for the opportunity to continue beyond the initial contract
- Hybrid working with 2 days from home and 3 days on-site
- Flexible start and finish times around the core working hours
- Free on-site parking
- A supportive and established finance team
- A streamlined MS Teams interview process
- The opportunity to join quickly in an urgent and business-critical position
